errors.text: Interprets ambient temperature as a fixed room-temperature condition rather than the controlled 300–1200 K temperature variable.
Replaces the FeNiCrCoCu/Cu atomistic coating system and nanoindentation-friction simulation with generic thermally sprayed HEA/steel coatings and macroscopic sliding tests.
Misses the observed 900 K degradation boundary and instead proposes unsupported hardness, intermetallic-fraction, and flash-temperature thresholds.

Attributes performance to tribolayer formation, configurational-entropy stabilization, and brittle intermetallics rather than the target transition from stacking-fault/dislocation-mediated deformation to lattice disorder and thermal softening.
Does not predict stable hardness through 600 K, the elastic-modulus maximum at 600 K, or the sharp hardness and wear-resistance decline with increasing friction above 900 K.
The cited evidence does not establish the quantitative thresholds of 400–500 HV, 30% brittle phases, or 200 °C.
